answer_1.quote: We develop MARS, Multimodal lAnguage Model with nonveRbal-cueS, a multimodal conversational agent capable of understanding and generating nonverbal cues alongside textual context in dialogues.
answer_1.outputs: MARS generates both text and nonverbal cues (facial expressions and body language) in dialogue contexts, interleaving <FACE_*> and <BODY_*> tokens with text.

answer_2.quote: We use Perplexity (PPL) as a general measure for both text and nonverbal tokens. For text tokens, we use BERT-score and METEOR as evaluation metrics, while for nonverbal tokens, we rely on Negative log-likelihood (NLL).

answer_4.quote: Finally, we evaluate the multimodal conversational modeling capabilities of the MARS LLM in section 5.3... supported by user studies, quantitative evaluations, and qualitative analyses.
answer_4.guideline: User studies were conducted to assess the effectiveness of MARS in generating contextually aligned nonverbal expressions and richer, more expressive listener responses.
